_doc: Single source of truth for all MQTT topics (C++: generated include/buddy/topics.hpp, Python: buddy_shared.topics).
Scheme buddy/<service>/<name>. Every service also has buddy/<service>/status = online|offline (retained, last will).
event: something happened or a state changed, published only by the owning service.
command: something should happen, consumed only by the owning service.
payload: the JSON object's fields, 'name: values' where useful, [optional]. planned: no service uses it yet.
web: false = a command the web panel may not publish (it has no login, D19: nothing that moves).

topics.name: hue_cmd
payload: [device: room, zone or light as spoken]

topics.name: hue_state
payload: rooms: [{id, name, kind: home|room|zone, on, brightness, lights: [ids], scenes: [{id, name}]}]
lights: [{id, name, room, on, brightness, color, temperature, dimming, [mirek], [xy]}]
